title: Lisa and the Colors in the Sunbeam
synopsis: When a rainbow appears on Grandpa’s sleeve, Lisa follows the light to a little glass prism and tries to find where the colors go.

related_resources.reason: A prism can separate sunlight into visible colors; this is physical background for the appearance of the colored band.
Lisa moves her attention between the colored patch, the prism, and the passing cloud; guided noticing is an optional reading conversation.
